# SoraSlider

Chooses a number from a range with a native range input.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { SoraSlider } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraSlider from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraSlider'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraSlider.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/SoraSlider.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Label text. It is the accessible name of the control. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text below the control, announced as its description. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id of the native control. Generated (and stable) when omitted. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keeps the label for assistive technology but hides it visually. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | `horizontal` puts the label beside the control when the container is wide enough. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `color` | `SoraColor` | `'primary'` | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the current value next to the track. |
| `formatValue` | `((value: number) => string)` |  | Human-readable value (also used for `aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + ' %'`. |
| `controlAttrs` | `SoraControlAttrs` |  | Attributes, listeners and a `ref` callback for the native control, for example Formisch's `field.props`. |

## Attributes

class/style go to the root; every other attribute and listener (and `controlAttrs`) goes to the native control.

## Keyboard

- Arrow keys change by `step`; Home/End jump to `min`/`max`; Page Up/Down by a larger step (native).

## Accessibility

- Native `<input type="range">` with `min`, `max` and `step`; mirrors in right-to-left text.
- `formatValue` also supplies `aria-valuetext`; the visible value is an `<output>` tied to the input.

## Styling

- `.sora-field`, `.sora-field__label`, `.sora-field__hint`, `.sora-field__error`
- `.sora-slider`, `.sora-slider__input`, `.sora-slider__value`
- `data-color`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid max-w-md gap-3">
  <SoraSlider v-model="volume" :label="t('demo.volume')" show-value />
  <SoraSlider
    v-model="volume"
    :label="t('demo.volume')"
    color="secondary"
    :step="10"
    show-value
    :format-value="(value) => `${value} %`"
  />
  <SoraSlider :model-value="30" :label="t('demo.disabled')" disabled />
</div>
```
